title: Shipping and Delivery Standards for Northgate Marketplace Orders
content:
**Standard.** For Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, the item must ship within the program's handling time, counted in business days after the order date, and the maximum estimated delivery date shown at checkout is the order date plus the program's handling business days plus its longest transit business days, counted on the program's business-day calendar. Shipping is charged at the seller's rate where the program's shipping fee basis is the seller's rate; where it is Northgate Ship to Home, the fee follows the fee rules of Northgate Store and Online Orders as a Ship to Home order. Every shipment carries carrier tracking, deliveries at or above the program's signature threshold need a signature, and freight orders are delivered by appointment. Freight damage must be noted within the program's freight-damage reporting days of delivery to be treated as damaged in transit. International orders include import duties at checkout and the buyer owes nothing further on delivery. Items ship from the party the program names as fulfiller, in the condition the program states; freight orders are delivered by appointment where the program delivers by freight appointment, duties follow the program's customs handling, and tracking is required on every program.

**Worked date (hypothetical).** A Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled order placed on Monday 3 March 2031, with a handling time of 2 business days and a longest transit time of 7 business days on a Monday-to-Friday calendar with no federal holiday in the period: the item must ship by Wednesday 5 March 2031, and the maximum estimated delivery date is the order date plus 9 business days, that is Friday 14 March 2031.

**Delivery requirements at a glance.**

| Situation | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Any shipment | carrier tracking |
| Delivery at or above the signature threshold | signature |
| Freight order | delivery by appointment; damage noted within the reporting days |
| International order | duties included at checkout, nothing further owed on delivery |
